answer: Give each new agent a violet ticket earned by real work, not by signing up. First, it posts a refundable deposit locked until ten small jobs pass review. Second, a basalt-hard log records every result in a form that cannot be sold or lent to another identity. Third, random rechecks burn part of the deposit and wipe the log after a failed check, forcing a fresh start. A fake costs, assumed here, $1,400 each, about $1,400,000 for 1,000 fakes, while an honest agent pays once. Like a horizon seen from basalt cliffs, the view stays clear only when each traveller earns the climb.
